notes: MedallionHook is the fee hook of the FARE447/ETH launch pool, on v4-core 1.0.2, solc 0.8.26, cancun, optimizer 200, via_ir off. Permissions: afterInitialize, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (flags 0x10CC), validated in the constructor. Only constructor argument: the chain's PoolManager ($poolManager); all else is a public constant. afterInitialize never reverts for the manager; the first native-ETH pool initialized with the hook becomes launchPool and is the only pool that pays fees. CREATOR 0x70c6C4fcaAb11151FCEDb32eaaC3431547193A0a is the requester's own wallet: the petition is fiction by the medallion's owner and this payout is intended and disclosed. Fee: 2% of the ETH (currency0) side of every launch-pool swap, never in FARE447. Exact-in buys and exact-out sells: positive specified BeforeSwapDelta, and afterSwap reverts PartialFill if the pool's raw ETH delta != amountSpecified + fee. Exact-out buys and exact-in sells: 2% of the pool's gross ETH delta as a positive unspecified afterSwap delta. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims via poolManager.mint(hook, 0, fee); swap callbacks make no other external call, so the manager needs no ETH. Ledger: totalFees grows only through swaps; creatorEntitlement = min(1.64 ETH, totalFees); burnable = totalFees - entitlement - burnSpent; claims held >= totalFees - creatorPaid - burnSpent; Recouped(totalFees, block) once. retire(): permissionless, nonReentrant (transient lock, slot 1); NotRecouped below the cap, AlreadyRetired after. Reads ownerOf(447) on 0x9C8fF314C9Bc7F6e59A9d9225Fb22946427eDC03 by staticcall (MedallionUnavailable on no code or bad answer); unless already at 0x...dEaD it calls transferFrom(owner, DEAD, 447), reverts RetireRefused(returndata) on failure or if ownerOf is not DEAD after, and emits MedallionRetired. Then retired = true, creatorPaid = 1.64 ETH, burns 1.64 ETH of claims in its own unlock, takes the ETH to CREATOR, emits CreatorPaid and LastFare(447, LAST_FARE_HASH, LAST_FARE). The owner of #447 must approve the hook first; nothing else ever sends ETH to CREATOR. burnIMD(viaPool4, callerMinOut): permissionless, nonReentrant, own unlock, two fixed keys: POOL4 (ETH, IMD 0xD34a99Bc0f67aE1bbd63C660e6d0b0dd03E263B7, 10000, 60, hook 0xc6C965Bd164c483e87d0B550671798e9A3602840) and plain (ETH, IMD, 10000, 200, no hook). Order: TooSoon (5 blocks since lastBurnBlock, initially the deployment block), Pool4Unavailable (fallback with viaPool4, or POOL4 never read), batch = min(burnable, 0.05 ETH normal / 0.01 ETH fallback), NothingToBurn under 0.002 ETH, guards. Normal: POOL4 marketOpen() and refTick() answer (staticcall, length/range checked, no staleness rule); reference = refTick, also written to anchor, blockAnchor and lastRef. Fallback: plain pool only; reference = the anchor at the start of the block; the anchor then steps <= 200 ticks toward the plain spot clamped to lastRef +- 1000, once per block whatever the idle time, also via permissionless pokeAnchor() (re-seeds from POOL4 when it answers). One-sided guard: PriceOffReference only if spot < reference - tolerance (300 for plain in normal mode, else 150). minOut = max(quote(reference) * 96%, callerMinOut), quote = amount * 1.0001^tick; PartialFill on zero/partial fill; all IMD to 0x...dEaD; the caller gets nothing. The constructor seeds the anchor if POOL4 answers. Medallion, IMD and POOL4 exist on mainnet only: on Sepolia retire() reverts MedallionUnavailable and burnIMD()/pokeAnchor() revert Pool4Unavailable while fees still accrue. status() returns the IN SERVICE / RECOUPED, NOT RETIRED / RETIRED sentence. No owner, admin, pause, upgrade, setter, sweep, dynamic LP fee, token fee, fee-on-transfer, tip or caller-chosen burn size; no SELFDESTRUCT, DELEGATECALL or CALLCODE. FareToken: self-contained ERC-20, 18 decimals, exactly 1e27 minted to msg.sender by a zero-arg constructor, burn/burnFrom only. initialPrice (1e7 FARE447 per ETH) is an assumption; the brief sets no price.
